pkgmetadata.longdescription: d2-mcp is a Rust Model Context Protocol server that invokes the installed D2 CLI to validate, format, and render diagrams as SVG or PNG. It serves local clients over stdio; no network service or editor configuration is installed. D2_MCP_D2_BIN can select the D2 executable and D2_MCP_WORKDIR selects the server-local output directory.
